description: Language conformance suite. Any Baa implementation should produce these outputs and these diagnostic codes.
notes: `programs` map a source string to the exact stdout it must produce, and the exit code.
`diagnostics` map a source string to the diagnostic codes it must report, in order.
`stage` is `check` when the codes must be reported without executing, `run` otherwise.
Randomness is seeded with 7. Programs depending on the clock or filesystem are excluded.

programs.name: truthiness
programs.source: baa !nil, !false, !0, !"", ![]

programs.name: operators/logical
programs.source: baa nil ?? 5, false ?? 5, 0 ?? 5, false && 1, true || 1

programs.name: operators/in
programs.source: baa 2 in [1, 2], "a" in { a: 1 }, 3 in 0..5, "oo" in "wool"

programs.name: strings/interpolation
programs.source:
const n = 3
baa "there are {n + 1} sheep and {["a", "b"].join(", ")}"
programs.stdout: there are 4 sheep and a, b

programs.name: strings/escapes
programs.source: baa "a\nb", "\{literal\}", "\u{1F411}"

programs.name: strings/indexing
programs.source: baa "wool"[0], "wool"[-1], "wool".length()

programs.name: arrays/methods
programs.source:
const a = [3, 1, 2]
baa a.sort(), a.reverse(), a.sum(), a.slice(1, 3)

programs.name: arrays/higher-order
programs.source: baa [1, 2, 3].map(fn(n) { return n * 2 }).filter(fn(n) { return n > 2 }).reduce(fn(t, n) { return t + n }, 0)

programs.name: maps/order
maps/missing-key
programs.source:
const m = { a: 1 }
baa m["z"], m.get("z", 0), m.has("a")

programs.name: maps/data-beats-methods
programs.source:
const m = { keys: "mine" }
baa m.keys

programs.name: control/if
control/for
control/break-continue
control/while
functions/params
programs.source:
fn f(a, b = 10, ..rest) { return [a, b, rest] }
baa f(1), f(1, 2), f(1, 2, 3, 4)

programs.name: functions/closures
functions/hoisting
functions/implicit-nil
programs.source:
fn f() { baa 1 }
baa f()

programs.name: match/arms
match/structural
programs.source: baa match [true, false] { [true, true] => "both", [true, false] => "first", _ => "no" }

programs.name: errors/throw-catch
programs.source: try { throw { code: "X" } } catch e { baa e.code }

programs.name: errors/runtime-catch
programs.source: try { baa [1][9] } catch e { baa e.code, e.line }

programs.name: errors/finally
scope/shadowing
values/reference-semantics
programs.source:
const a = [1]
const b = a
b.push(2)
const c = clone(a)
c.push(3)
baa a, c

programs.name: prelude
programs.source: baa len([1, 2]), type_of(1.5), to_string([1]), to_number("42"), inspect("a")
